meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Transfer operation of a customer deployment with ownership, evidence and a tested support path. Use for handoff or an engineer rotation, not merely code delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把在运行的客户系统的运维责任与支撑路径完整移交给接手的工程师。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把在运行的客户系统交给新的运维或值班工程师。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're transferring a running customer deployment to a new owner.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会在客户部署交接或工程师轮换的场景下,按任务上下文契约与 close 方法执行,产出包含归属、证据和已测试支持路径的操作交接。
howto.when: 当你需要做客户部署交接或工程师轮换时触发,原文说明它不适用于单纯的代码交付;若由 @fde 调用,会复用其已脱敏的上下文包与范围。

say.text: 帮我做这次客户部署的交接,记下归属和证据
say.note: 按 close 方法整理交接记录

say.text: 工程师要轮换了,把当前部署的运维交出去
say.note: 复用已有上下文,不重新初始化

say.text: 把这次交接的支持路径验证一下,没跑的检查如实说明
say.note: 未执行的检查不会谎报

howto.what_en: After install, Claude handles customer deployment handoffs and engineer rotations per the task context contract and the close method, producing an operational transfer with ownership, evidence and a tested support path.
howto.when_en: Triggers on a customer deployment handoff or an engineer rotation, not on plain code delivery. When invoked by @fde it reuses that sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Do the handoff for this customer deployment and record ownership and evidence.
An engineer is rotating; transfer operation of the current deployment.
Verify the support path for this handoff and report unrun checks.
